variants.headline: Household savings committed to a company plan
variants.body: The settler {founder} has committed household savings to a plan for {business}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: An enterprise begins as a household risk
variants.body: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A settler backs a business idea
variants.body: The founder {founder} has backed a plan for {business} with household savings. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
